charts.title: HD 21520 b: orbits around HD 21520
charts.description: The orbits of HD 21520's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 21520 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Nies et al. 2024 (2024MNRAS.534.3744N), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname NIES_ET_AL_2024): P 25.1292 d

charts.title: HD 21520 b: its transit
charts.description: HD 21520 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (97, 105, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 404518509, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 30 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 20-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min early; 20-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 10 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
